A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
